title: Switch orbit controls to bumpers
objective: Change the flashlight orbit collection teleop controls so target selection and orbit preview use right/left bumpers instead of top/bottom face buttons. Keep existing flashlight toggle/aim behavior intact. Update local example usage docs/comments that mention these controls.
instructions: Inspect examples/flashlight/run_orbit_collection.py and docs that mention Gamepad_FaceButton_Top or Gamepad_FaceButton_Bottom for orbit collection.
Change target selection to the right bumper and orbit preview to the left bumper, per user request: Top and Bottom face buttons is a no-no; use right and left bumpers.
Do not disturb existing co-located flashlight intensity/direction support or existing flashlight toggle/D-pad aim behavior.
Update README/help text or docs near the script that users will rely on for controls.
Run focused non-sim validation after the change.
expected_outputs: Files changed and exact control mapping after the change.
definition_of_done: No remaining user-facing mention suggests top/bottom face buttons are used for orbit select/preview.
Focused validation passes without a simulator.
